      "title": "MetaBrain - Tampermonkey project chat prompt sender debugging",
      "turn_index": 9,
      "role": "assistant",
      "snippet": "Below is a Tampermonkey userscript that will:

Enumerate chats from the left sidebar (conversation links)

Open each chat in a new tab (one at a time)

Paste your Memory Extraction Prompt

Send it

Close the tab (optional)

Move to next chat

It is designed as a two-part system:

Controller tab (your current ChatGPT tab) that iterates chats and opens them

Worker tab (each opened chat) that pastes + sends

This separation is more reliable than trying to navigate the same tab.
